metadata.description: This is a copy of the 2023-09-12 dump in stackexchange. It contains all files present in that item at the time of mirroring on 2023-11-19. Why? The stackexchange item gets overwritten periodically, and the old dumps become hard to impossible to access. Cf. the Meta SE discussion: All Stack Exchange data dumps Licence In 2019, Stack Exchange Inc. unilaterally announced that the licence would be changed from CC-BY-SA version 3.0 to version 4.0. The general opinion is that this move was not legal because all past contributors would have had to give explicit permission. As such, old content is licensed under version 3.0 while newer one runs under 4.0, but it is difficult to determine which licence applies to a particular piece of content. The 2016 MIT licence situation further complicates this. Please refer to these discussions on Meta SE for more details: Stack Exchange and Stack Overflow have moved to CC BY-SA 4.0 and The MIT License – Clarity on Using Code on Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange.
